news.title: Cantor Fitzgerald Initiates Coverage at Overweight
news.text: Cantor Fitzgerald began covering Kratos with an Overweight rating and a $335 price target, citing growth prospects across defense platforms.

news.title: Shares Jump on Space Force Task Order
news.text: Kratos stock climbed over 10% after securing a $25 million U.S. Space Force satellite communications support task order and other positive developments.

news.title: Airbus Partnership Delivers Valkyrie Drones to Germany
news.text: Kratos partnered with Airbus Defence and Space to supply XQ-58A Valkyrie drones to the German Air Force with mission systems integration for 2029 deployment.

news.title: RBC Capital Raises Target to $300
news.text: RBC Capital lifted its price target from $275 to $300 and reiterated an Outperform rating on Kratos.

news.title: 5G NTN Demonstration with Intelsat
news.text: Kratos and Intelsat successfully demonstrated 5G non-terrestrial network connectivity over GEO satellites, highlighting communications expertise.

news.title: Automated Truck Platoon Supports NASCAR Logistics
news.text: Kratos and Champion Tire & Wheel launched an automated truck platoon to streamline logistics for the NASCAR Brickyard 400.

news.title: Earnings Beat Sends Shares Higher
news.text: Kratos reported Q2 EPS of $0.11 on $351.5 million revenue versus expectations of $0.09 and $305.8 million, boosting stock 9.4% and driving guidance increases.

news.title: Pentagon Calls for Advanced Uncrewed Systems
news.text: Kratos shares gained 13% after a Pentagon memo emphasized accelerating advanced uncrewed systems, reinforcing demand for the company's platforms.

news.title: Added to S&P MidCap 400 Index
news.text: Kratos joined the S&P MidCap 400 Index, reflecting increased market prominence within the defense sector.

news.title: Exclusive Manufacturing Deal with Elroy Air
news.text: Kratos became Elroy Air's exclusive manufacturing partner for the Chaparral cargo drone under a five-year strategic arrangement.

news.title: Altitude Testing Begins on GEK800 Engine
news.text: Kratos and GE Aerospace commenced altitude testing on the jointly developed GEK800 engine for next-generation unmanned aircraft systems.

news.title: Preliminary Design Review Completed for AFCGI
news.text: Kratos completed the preliminary design review for the Space Development Agency's AFCGI system, moving the program forward.

news.title: U.S. Navy Awards AN/SPY-1 Sustainment Contract
news.text: The Navy granted Kratos a Phase 1 contract to sustain AN/SPY-1 radar systems with a potential ceiling of $175 million across multiple phases.

news.title: Citizens JMP Raises Price Target to $105
news.text: Citizens JMP Securities lifted its Kratos price target from $70 to $105, highlighting growing demand for defense solutions.

news.title: Canaccord Boosts Target to $120
news.text: Canaccord Genuity increased its price target to $120 citing momentum across Kratos' portfolio.

news.title: Truist Raises Target to $125
news.text: Truist elevated its price target to $125 with continued optimism over Kratos' growth trajectory.

news.title: Hypersonic Materials Testing Center Contract
news.text: Kratos won a $68.3 million contract under Project Helios to build a hypersonic materials testing center supporting U.S. defense capabilities.

news.title: Strategic Partnership with Korean Aerospace Industries
news.text: Kratos formed a strategic partnership with Korean Aerospace Industries to advance manned-unmanned teaming and expand international collaboration.
